summary: Add a bounded 2026-08-26 internal SingleCamera test-readiness milestone with separate UI, safety-blocker, exact-SHA candidate, and operator-controlled one-shot work. Keep Dual hardware capture, A0 quality acceptance, durability, packaging, and release outside the Wednesday completion claim.
non_completion_guards: M3T completion is internal test readiness only and does not complete M1A, M3, M4, MVP acceptance, packaging, or release
the Wednesday physical lane is exactly-one SingleCamera only; incomplete Dual capture, binding, and stitch paths remain HardwarePending and disabled
GitHub billing or runner failure blocks an exact-SHA CI claim and must not be converted into a code PASS or release PASS
Issue 94 shutdown and Issue 131 WPD read-bound fixes must be verified before a real one-shot; unresolved Issue 130 keeps Dual disabled
real camera work still requires explicit operator resume, identity-v3 read-only readiness, one D810, and a dedicated spool with zero payload objects
one successful capture does not prove ten-run characterization, HG-0009 p95, 100-run acceptance, Dual hardware operation, stitching, or A0 output quality
no camera serial, SDK archive or licensed binary, credential, customer original, captured image, or non-redacted hardware identity may be committed
